prompt: Build EpisodeFeed around a private list of the provided Episode records and implement the aggregate queries: totals, per-show minutes, distinct sorted shows, the longest episode and the average.
explanation: Each query is a single pass over the composed list with an accumulator, which is the standard shape for aggregates over a collection you own. The longest() method tracks a best-so-far and uses a strict > comparison so the first episode added wins a tie. Guarding averageMinutes() against an empty feed avoids a division by zero and keeps the contract simple.
hints: Every aggregate is an enhanced for loop over the private list with a running total or a best-so-far variable.
For longest(), start with null and only replace the best when the new episode is strictly longer.
To get a distinct sorted list, add names you have not seen yet and then call Collections.sort on the result.
